---
title: "Step 1 Robustness Analyses (Decision resubmission, editor point 2)"
output: html_document
---

1. Participant bootstrap of ridge coefficients at the selected lambda: sign consistency per item
   and per factor.
2. Feature importance for non-decision time (theta), descriptively.
3. Bootstrap CI on out-of-sample R² from the held-out predictions of nested CV (no refitting
   inside the bootstrap).

Inputs: `ridge_inputs.RData`, written by the "Save the ridge inputs" chunk of
`DDM_STDDM_Regression.Rmd`. Run that notebook through that chunk first. Each section saves its
own results to `step1_outputs/`, so later sections never refit.

# Setup

```{r}
suppressMessages({
  library(glmnet)
  library(data.table)
})

base_dir <- "C:/Users/Brian Kim/Documents/OneDrive - Drexel University/Documents/classes/cognew/Neuroethics/IndividualDifferenceRiskBenefit/DATA_ANALYSIS/analysis/finalDDM"
load(file.path(base_dir, "ridge_inputs.RData"))   # final_table, data_matrix, predictors, dependent_vars, ridge_lambdas, ...

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "step1_outputs")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Parameters predicted out of sample; the main text interprets only these.
main_params <- c(time = "time", harm_sensitivity = "b_risk", nondecision_time = "theta")

n_boot <- 1000

# Same outcome scaling as the published ridge fits
standardized_outcome <- function(param) as.numeric(scale(final_table[[param]]))
```

Sign conventions, so a positive coefficient can be read in words. s > 0 = left (harm) attribute
enters before right (cure).

```{r}
for (p in main_params) {
  cat(sprintf("%-7s mean = %+.3f, %% positive = %.1f\n",
              p, mean(final_table[[p]]), 100 * mean(final_table[[p]] > 0)))
}
```

# Factor Definitions

Items belonging to each factor discussed in the main text, with keying. A factor-level
coefficient is the sum of its item coefficients after flipping reverse-keyed items, so it reads
as "higher on the trait". Without keying, BFI-2 items cancel: each domain is half reverse-worded.

The published SNS key reverse-codes Q7 (Fagerlin et al., 2007), but SNS7 is treated as forward
here. In the main collection it correlates positively with SNS6 (+.36) and SNS8 (+.30), unlike
the pilot, and its ridge coefficients share the sign of the other SNS items. Set
`sns7_reversed <- TRUE` to apply the published key instead.

```{r}
big5_reverse <- c(3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 11, 12, 16, 17, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 28, 29, 30,
                  31, 36, 37, 42, 44, 45, 47, 48, 49, 50, 51, 55, 58)   # Soto & John (2017)
big5_domain <- function(first) paste0("BIG5_", seq(first, 60, by = 5))

factor_items <- list(
  "Berlin Numeracy"        = paste0("Berlin", 1:4, "1"),   # dummy = answered correctly
  "Subjective Numeracy"    = paste0("SNS", 1:8),
  "GRiPS"                  = paste0("GRiPS_", 1:8),
  "BIG5 Extraversion"      = big5_domain(1),
  "BIG5 Agreeableness"     = big5_domain(2),
  "BIG5 Conscientiousness" = big5_domain(3),
  "BIG5 Neg. Emotionality" = big5_domain(4),
  "BIG5 Open-Mindedness"   = big5_domain(5)
)
sns7_reversed <- FALSE
reverse_keyed <- c(paste0("BIG5_", big5_reverse), if (sns7_reversed) "SNS7")

missing <- setdiff(unlist(factor_items), colnames(data_matrix))
if (length(missing)) stop("Not in data_matrix: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

item_keying <- setNames(rep(1, ncol(data_matrix)), colnames(data_matrix))
item_keying[intersect(reverse_keyed, names(item_keying))] <- -1

factor_coefs <- function(coef_mat) {
  # coef_mat: rows = fits, cols = items. Returns rows = fits, cols = factors.
  sapply(factor_items, function(items) {
    coef_mat[, items, drop = FALSE] %*% item_keying[items]
  })
}
```

# 1. Participant Bootstrap of Ridge Coefficients

Resample participants with replacement, refit at the published lambda, keep every coefficient.
Direction claims rest on these sign proportions.

```{r}
bootstrap_coefs <- function(param, n_boot) {
  y <- standardized_outcome(param)
  lambda <- ridge_lambdas[[param]]
  t(replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(nrow(data_matrix), replace = TRUE)
    fit <- glmnet(data_matrix[idx, ], y[idx], alpha = 0, lambda = lambda)
    as.vector(coef(fit))[-1]
  }))
}

set.seed(2026)
boot_coefs <- lapply(main_params, function(p) {
  m <- bootstrap_coefs(p, n_boot)
  colnames(m) <- colnames(data_matrix)
  m
})
save(boot_coefs, file = file.path(out_dir, "boot_coefs.RData"))
```

## 1a. Sign Consistency Summaries

```{r}
full_sample_coefs <- function(param) {
  fit <- glmnet(data_matrix, standardized_outcome(param), alpha = 0,
                lambda = ridge_lambdas[[param]])
  setNames(as.vector(coef(fit))[-1], colnames(data_matrix))
}

sign_summary <- function(coef_mat, full) {
  data.table(
    term        = colnames(coef_mat),
    estimate    = full,
    boot_median = apply(coef_mat, 2, median),
    ci_low      = apply(coef_mat, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    ci_high     = apply(coef_mat, 2, quantile, 0.975),
    sign_agree  = colMeans(sign(coef_mat) == sign(rep(full, each = nrow(coef_mat))))
  )
}

item_signs <- rbindlist(lapply(names(main_params), function(nm) {
  full <- full_sample_coefs(main_params[[nm]])
  cbind(parameter = nm, sign_summary(boot_coefs[[nm]], full))
}))

factor_signs <- rbindlist(lapply(names(main_params), function(nm) {
  full <- factor_coefs(matrix(full_sample_coefs(main_params[[nm]]), nrow = 1,
                              dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(data_matrix))))
  cbind(parameter = nm, sign_summary(factor_coefs(boot_coefs[[nm]]), as.vector(full)))
}))

fwrite(item_signs,   file.path(out_dir, "sign_consistency_items.csv"))
fwrite(factor_signs, file.path(out_dir, "sign_consistency_factors.csv"))
print(factor_signs[, lapply(.SD, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) signif(v, 3) else v)])
```

The published pipeline already computed this (`importance_results$theta`) but it was never
reported. Summarize it the same way as the other parameters.

```{r}
theta_importance <- as.data.table(importance_results$theta)
item_to_factor <- setNames(rep(names(factor_items), lengths(factor_items)), unlist(factor_items))
theta_importance[, factor := item_to_factor[Feature]]   # NA = item outside the main-text factors
fwrite(theta_importance, file.path(out_dir, "theta_feature_importance.csv"))
print(head(theta_importance, 15))
```

# 3. Held-Out Predictions from Nested CV

Same procedure as the published nested CV (10 outer x 10 inner folds, 10 repeats) but the
held-out predictions are kept. This is the slow chunk.

```{r}
nested_cv_predictions <- function(x, y, n_folds = 10) {
  outer_folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(n_folds), length.out = length(y)))
  pred <- numeric(length(y))
  for (k in seq_len(n_folds)) {
    test <- outer_folds == k
    inner_fit <- cv.glmnet(x[!test, , drop = FALSE], y[!test], alpha = 0)
    pred[test] <- predict(inner_fit, newx = x[test, , drop = FALSE], s = "lambda.min")
  }
  pred
}

r2 <- function(y, pred) 1 - sum((y - pred)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)

n_repeats <- 10
set.seed(1234)
heldout_preds <- lapply(main_params, function(p) {
  y <- standardized_outcome(p)
  list(y = y, preds = replicate(n_repeats, nested_cv_predictions(data_matrix, y)))
})
save(heldout_preds, file = file.path(out_dir, "heldout_preds.RData"))
```

## 3a. Bootstrap CI on Out-of-Sample R²

Resample participants from the held-out predictions and recompute R². This captures sampling
variability of the evaluation set, not of the model fitting; fold-partition variability is the
10-repeat range reported alongside.

```{r}
bootstrap_r2 <- function(y, preds, n_boot) {
  replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(length(y), replace = TRUE)
    mean(apply(preds[idx, , drop = FALSE], 2, function(p) r2(y[idx], p)))
  })
}

set.seed(2026)
r2_table <- rbindlist(lapply(names(main_params), function(nm) {
  h <- heldout_preds[[nm]]
  repeat_r2 <- apply(h$preds, 2, function(p) r2(h$y, p))
  boot <- bootstrap_r2(h$y, h$preds, n_boot)
  data.table(parameter   = nm,
             R2          = mean(repeat_r2),
             repeat_min  = min(repeat_r2),
             repeat_max  = max(repeat_r2),
             ci_low      = quantile(boot, 0.025),
             ci_high     = quantile(boot, 0.975),
             p_boot_le_0 = mean(boot <= 0))
}))

fwrite(r2_table, file.path(out_dir, "r2_bootstrap_ci.csv"))
print(r2_table[, lapply(.SD, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) round(100 * v, 2) else v)])
```
